items.title: Bob Hardaway interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 14, 1999
items.q: that he had been an arranger for Stan Kenton, which I didn’t know until afterwards.

ctx.x: Yes I did an album with Ken Hanna had quite a few solos actually to play on that album, and that was a good band, a local band. It never went anywhere. I think Ken was a — I

learned this after I was on the band — that he had been an arranger for Stan Kenton, which I didn’t know until afterwards. But that was a good band. That’s a pretty good album. Every ten, fifteen years I may get it out and play it again.
Yeah. Check it out. See if it’s holding up.
